d: When a mysterious circular stone structure is discovered in Scotland, experts investigate whether it's the fabled Round Table of King Arthur.
When experts investigate a network of tunnels rumoured to be the hiding place of lost royal treasure, they find evidence of human sacrifice for the Viking god Odin.

UFOs appear over three of Sweden’s power plants, two airports and the Royal Palace. Is the country about to be attacked by some unearthly force? A serviceman who says he encountered a UFO finally receives a medical payout from the US military.

A mysterious craft rises out of the Costa Rican jungle and is captured on camera. Some say it’s the best footage of a UFO they’ve ever seen. But could it also reveal some of the technical secrets behind otherworldy engineering.
When a labyrinth is discovered on an island once home to an ancient Greek civilization, experts investigate if it was the home of the Minotaur.
Bizarre underwater formations might point to a top-secret US weapons testing facility and a strange sighting in the Arctic could be a lost Nazi relic.

Triangle shaped hovering objects were seen by thousands of people and investigated by scientists and government officials, yet they could never be explained. The sightings occurred in a more than two year "wave" over Belgium, beginning in late 1989.

In the early 90’s, teenagers Adam and Gwen tell their story of red lights dancing in the sky, Julie recalls a terrifying drive home as she is chased by a UFO, experts offer theories of what they may have seen.

Tony tells of his close encounter as a 17 year old, now 60 years on the subject has become an obsession. Experienced pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying his plane.
A ghost ship is found abandoned on a remote island that's home to one of the world's last uncontacted tribes.

t: Weird Or What? With William Shatner
st: Falling Man, Space Rocks, Missing Feet
d: A high-rise window washer somehow survives a 50-storey fall and basketball-sized ice chunks fall from the sky.

st: Billy Meier, The Plejaren and the Multiverse, 1975
d: Billy Meier claims he's traveled through time and space with an alien race from the Pleiades star cluster; in the decades following his revelation, both skeptics and ufologists say it's a hoax despite Meier providing photographic evidence.
Roswell remains the most controversial UFO story of all time. What will a new discovery at the fabled crash site reveal about the incident? Also, hundreds witness a crashed UFO south of Pittsburgh.

Collating thousands of sightings and happenings, UFO X Files delves deep into the once classified top secret files. Hidden away for decades, these files allow us to investigate one of the great unanswered questions of our time: do UFOs really exist.

st: Dolphin Saviours, Grim Reapers, Hysterical Strength
d: A look at dolphin rescues, death-smelling pets and a skinny teen with unbelievable strength.

st: Sea Lions, Voynich Manuscript, Cocaine Mummies
d: Did San Francisco's sea lions sense an impending disaster, what are the secrets of a mysterious medieval manuscript, and why do mummies in Egypt contain cocaine from Peru.
Mysterious satellite images reveal China's hidden terror camps and provide access to America's top secret apocalypse pyramid.
Satellites capture unusual images including markings in the desert, while a strange symbol could be a portal into a lost South American civilisation.

One of the world’s best UFO hotspots is very close to home. Craig and Sarah examine the Scottish UFO phenomena — a myriad of extraordinary cases, including the 1991 sighting of a glowing red disc. This programme contains some flashing images.

On 13 March 1997 in the night sky over Phoenix, Arizona one of the most spectacular mass UFO sighting of all time took place. Thousands witnessed bright orange orbs moving in formation. This programme contains some flashing images.
If aliens have visited Earth, what are their intentions? Do they wish to experiment on the human body, or the human mind as well.
Alien encounters have offered a possible glimpse into the secrets of interstellar navigation. Could this one day ensure mankind's survival.
